build.buildCommand: pnpm install && pnpm --filter @rpg/database prisma generate && pnpm --filter @rpg/shared build && pnpm --filter @rpg/database build && pnpm --filter @rpg/backend build && pnpm --filter @rpg/frontend build

deploy.preDeployCommand: pnpm --filter @rpg/database prisma generate && pnpm --filter @rpg/database prisma db push --accept-data-loss --skip-generate
